cipBook.title: County of Marin FY 2027-31 Proposed Capital Improvement Plan
cipBook.note: Attachment E, CIP book. Figures are read from the tables on pages 19, 21 and 24-27; the other pages are narrative and images.
cipBook.urlNote: The Public Works page that hosts the CIP book PDF. Replace with the PDF address to link to the file itself.
notes: Figures are whole dollars as the book prints them.
Projects are listed as the book lists them; the book names no department or fund for a project.
On a project, funding in the plan is its prior approvals plus the five programmed years; programmed is the five years only.
A project's cost estimate is its funding in the plan plus the additional funds still needed.
cipBook.statedProjectCountNote: The number of projects the book's text gives (page 4); its tables list a different number.

schemaGov.note: Projects, budgets and budget lines follow schemaGov. The BudgetLine project link is proposed and not yet in the schema.
